backpack_management.stack_button: Merges same item types (healing, ammo, throwables).
backpack_management.sliding_discard_bar: Smooth quantity selection for dropping stacked items.

looting_system.stacked_looting_list: Same item types stacked in loot boxes.

ui_hud_optimizations.med_kit_wheel: Auto-switches to Super Med at 75 HP instead of 58 HP.
ui_hud_optimizations.auto_aim_adjustments: Prioritizes aiming at standing enemies over downed enemies in proximity.

shallow_water.downed_elimination_fix: Fixed instant elimination bug when knocked down in shallow water.

physics_and_environment.danger_zone_rules: If player is eliminated by Danger Zone within 8s of taking damage, kill credit goes to the last damage dealer.

network_and_performance.duo_network_connection: Auto-switches between best cellular and Wi-Fi networks in real-time.
network_and_performance.loading_time: BR pre-parachuting loading streamlined from 2 stages into 1 stage.

anti_cheat_compensation.solo_ranked_compensation: Rank points restored via in-game mail if eliminated by a cheater after cheater is banned.
